findings.title: Separate worksheet and delimiter status branches
findings.why_it_matters: The new worksheet arm is nested inside a CSV delimiter expression, so an Excel import announces a worksheet as a detected delimiter. The packed conditional also makes later source-specific status changes easy to apply to only one fragment of the sentence.
evidence: src/ui/Workspace.tsx:335:               ? `Source loaded · ${view.summary.candidates.toLocaleString()} candidate rows · ${view.worksheet ? `worksheet ${view.worksheet}` : view.delimiter === "\t" ? "tab" : view.delimiter === ";" ? "semicolon" : "comma"} delimiter detected. Verify the source columns below.`
findings.suggested_fix: Build the complete source detail before rendering: for Excel use `worksheet ${view.worksheet}`; for CSV use the current delimiter label followed by `delimiter detected`. Interpolate that complete detail into the shared row-count/status sentence.
